description: Earthquake Data is a data resource listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Public Data Resources > Resilience and Natural Hazards", published or maintained by as named on ngdc.noaa.gov. NOAA provided data includes a global record of significant earthquakes going back to 2150 BC to the present with geographic information. Coverage: as described in the entry; the linked page was not read. The list files it under "Public Data Resources > Resilience and Natural Hazards". The entry links to ngdc.noaa.gov. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-apa-urban-regional-planning-resources-list.
